name: @itwin/vitest-browser-bridge
description: Internal Vitest BrowserProvider and callback transport for Electron renderer tests

scripts.build: rimraf lib && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('lib/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }) + '\n')"
scripts.test: npm run -s build && npm run -s test:unit && npm run -s test:electron-provider:built
scripts.test:electron-provider: npm run -s build && npm run -s test:electron-provider:built
scripts.test:electron-provider:built: npm run -s build:test-fixtures && rimraf test-results && npm run -s test:electron-provider:esm && npm run -s test:electron-provider:cjs && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['test-results/electron-provider-esm.junit.xml','test-results/electron-provider-cjs.junit.xml']) if (!fs.existsSync(p) || !fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').includes('<testsuites')) process.exit(1)"
